data.name: Darting Claw
data.description: Evolved for snatching fast prey, a sharkeating crab is exceptionally quick with its claws. When making a full attack, if a shark-eating crab misses with both of its claw attacks, it can make an additional claw attack at a -2 penalty against any creature within its reach.
